nina (Product Design): quick review request — bulk invite/remove modal v3 in Figma: https://go.fig/nina/bulk-v3. main questions: inline field errors vs top summary, required markers in compact table, and confirmation patterns for destructive actions. pinging everyone for quick takes. tom (Design): row-level validation should be inline for fast fixes. top summary can show a count and link into rows (e.g. "3 rows need attention"). avoid full-page jumps when focusing errors. rob (PM): legal wants explicit "Required" for certain fields. could we do asterisk for most fields and full "Required" label for compliance-related ones? kai (Eng): inline errors are fine but watch layout shift — use fixed-height rows and reveal an error slot to prevent jumping. also add anchors from summary to row IDs for keyboard users. anya (A11y): accessibility notes: 1) asterisk alone is insufficient; add sr-only "required" copy or visible label for required/compliance fields. 2) error summary should be a focusable role="alert" so keyboard users land on it. 3) color cannot be the only error indicator and contrast must meet 4.5:1. tom (Design): for compact team lists: asterisk + tooltip saying "Required field"; expanded forms get full "Required" text. For destructive confirmation we sketched two flows: soft (single confirm modal + undo toast) and hard (two-step typed confirm "REMOVE" for large batches or org policy). which should be default? rob (PM): ops says accidental removes are painful. prefer hard path for large deletions. threshold should be org-configurable. kai (Eng): implementation notes: disable the confirm CTA until the typed value matches exactly; debounce paste events; server must re-verify before executing destructive job. for row fixes: update top count in real-time without forcing scrolling. anya (A11y): aria sample for modal: ```html
3 items need attention
Case-sensitive. Paste allowed, but must match exactly.
``` Also: when changing steps announce "Step 2 of 2: Confirm removal" via aria-live. ops-bot: telemetry suggestion: emit bulk_action_open, bulk_row_error_shown, bulk_row_error_fixed, bulk_confirm_attempt, bulk_confirm_success, bulk_confirm_cancel, bulk_undo_used. include org_id, user_role, device_type, affected_count. kai (Eng): mobile: avoid autofocus on iOS since keyboard can obscure context. if autofocus is used, ensure modal scrolls so CTA remains visible. trap focus and provide clear cancel. rob (PM): decision proposal: run an A/B test for 6 weeks. Variant A = inline errors + undo toast (30s). Variant B = stepper with typed confirm for >25 rows + undo (5m). Make threshold and confirm behavior configurable at org level. Track accidental_removal_rate and time_to_complete. tom (Design): i'll update mocks for both variants and add states: clean, errors, confirm-step, success with undo. microcopy drafts: Impact summary: "This will remove access for N members. This cannot be undone after the undo period." Typed confirm prompt: "To confirm, type REMOVE in the box below." nina (Product Design): next steps: tom to push updated Figma screens, kai to estimate effort (include mobile testing), anya to run a11y checklist, ops-bot to create telemetry ticket. scheduling 30min follow-up next Tue. thanks all :handshake:
